text:
li: Quick alert 

— onboarding Zephyrus-v0.2 (int8 qprofile) to canary triggered locale regressions across zh->en and he->en evals. Baseline fp16 zh->en BLEU 29.1 vs zephyrus-int8 25.0 on bench/xx_to_en_1k. he->en dropped ~3.6 BLEU.
li: Repro used eval runner:
```
python -m eval.translate --model zephyrus-v0.2 --quant int8 --dataset bench/xx_to_en_1k.jsonl --seed 42
```
li: Examples show stray space insertion around CJK punctuation and missing RLI/LRI marks for RTL. Sample:
```
src: 他問：\u300c我們什麼時候走？\u300d
fp16: He asked, \"When do we leave?\"
int8: He asked , \" When do we leave ?\"
```
li: Hebrew example: bracket order looks off around embedded English phrases.

sam: Could be detok normalization in the int8 kernel. Did the int8 fast path swap in a new unicode-normalizer?
sam: Any difference in tokenizer package versions?

jing: I checked token ids for the Chinese sentence — same across runs for the snippet:
```
fp16 ids: [210,4321,98,77,9001]
int8 ids: [210,4321,98,77,9001]
```
jing: But in full traces I see post-detok steps logging "norm: drop U+2067" and "norm: collapse U+200D" repeatedly. Those code points are RLI/ZWJ-like and are required for bidi and CJK ligatures.

priya: Dropping U+2066/U+2067 (LRI/RLI) and U+200D (ZWJ) on detok would definitely break RTL embedding and CJK joining. We shipped kernel-build tag `norm/fast-normalize-v3` with int8 canary yesterday.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment used kernel tag `norm/fast-normalize-v3` at 2026-03-20T04:22Z. Tokenizer package unchanged.

li: So root cause likely normalization policy in that kernel. Workaround: re-run int8 with env var TEXT_NORMALIZE=compat-preserve or runtime flag `--unicode-preserve` to avoid aggressive stripping.

sam: I'll run a 1k eval with unicode-preserve now. If BLEU recovers we confirm. ETA ~15m.

jing: Meanwhile I can make a minimal failing example: nested parentheses + mixed-hebrew with English acronym. I got a diff where fp16 detok preserves U+2067 but int8 path removed it. I'll open bug and attach logs.

priya: If confirmed, plan: pin int8 to previous kernel (norm/normalize-stable) for prod, block fast-normalize-v3, and add integration tests for zero-width and bidi control retention. Also add unit in eval harness for CJK punctuation spacing.

sam: Quick update — unicode-preserve int8 run BLEU: zh->en 28.9 (close to fp16), he->en 28.7. Looks like recovery.

li: Great, that pins it. priya can you open rollback PR and add a gating test?

priya: Opening PR now, adding test case named `eval/fixtures/zwc_bidi_cjk.jsonl` and a check in canary job. Will tag reviewers.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback to `norm/normalize-stable` started 2026-03-20T05:10Z to canary group canary-2.

li: Thanks. Let's keep this thread for updates. Also we should file follow-up to add a coverage test for RLI/LRI/ZWNJ/ZWJ retention in quantized fast paths.
